summary.en: Two players play a scene without seeing each other's faces.
summary.no: To spillere spiller en scene uten å se hverandres ansikter.

en: Sit back to back, so you can't see each other.
Play a full scene that way.
no: Sitt rygg mot rygg, så dere ikke ser hverandre.

more.en: Listening is everything. Variant, if both are comfortable: slow-dance cheek to shoulder.
more.no: Lytting er alt. Variant, hvis begge er komfortable med det: sakte dans, kinn mot skulder.
